design: One paired seed for each of six public scalar tasks; three indent-first and three brace-first pairs. Freeze model identity, settings, seed, and protocol hash before any model call.

analysis.tokens: indent/brace ratio only when both pass
analysis.failures: full token and wall budgets in all-task cost
analysis.uncertainty: deterministic task bootstrap, 4096 resamples, seed 18, percentile 2.5/97.5

scope: six public scalar tasks only; no whole-language or release claim
